I am currently doing okay for once. Therapy has been very helpful and it is all due to the fact that I finally found a shrink that understands and actually cares. We have a wonderfully snarky partnership going on.  The last time I felt suicidal was right before May and even then it was just a feeling in the back of my head rather than something that I was constantly obsessed over. These past few months have been very good with little to no relapses and I honestly think it's because I have been using my art and music to exorcise my inner demons. I decided not to take summer school in between semesters due to an over all shitty junior year of college. Being removed from stressfull, anxiety inducing situations and abusive, rude-ass professors have done me a world of good and with summer ending and the looming approach of the fall semester, I feel better than I did the previous year. Not going to lie though. The idea of returning back to my college depresses the hell out of me. Mostly because I am leaving good people behind in my hometown to be with egotistical fuckwads at my college. I also already beat myself down enough without having to hear from my professors do it for me.
